.github/workflows/case-pg-vertical-once..text:
name: ParkWeave Case PG vertical once (approval required)

on:
  push:
    branches: [dev/f2-case-pg-vertical-once-20261013]
    paths: ['scripts/case_pg_vertical/approval.json']

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: parkweave-case-pg-vertical-once-20261013
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  case-pg-vertical:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'T1doo/ParkWeave' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/dev/f2-case-pg-vertical-once-20261013' &&
      github.event.repository.private == false &&
      github.run_attempt == 1 && github.run_number == 1
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact approval commit without retained credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Owned PG regressions and Case persistence with closed output
        timeout-minutes: 23
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERTICAL_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          VERTICAL_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          VERTICAL_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          VERTICAL_EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          VERTICAL_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          VERTICAL_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          VERTICAL_PUBLIC: ${{ github.event.repository.private == false }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          env -i LANG=C.UTF-8 \
            VERTICAL_REPOSITORY="$VERTICAL_REPOSITORY" VERTICAL_REF="$VERTICAL_REF" \
            VERTICAL_EVENT="$VERTICAL_EVENT" VERTICAL_ATTEMPT="$VERTICAL_ATTEMPT" \
            VERTICAL_NUMBER="$VERTICAL_NUMBER" VERTICAL_PUBLIC="$VERTICAL_PUBLIC" \
            RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT="$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" RUNNER_OS="$RUNNER_OS" \
            /usr/bin/python3.12 -I -S -B scripts/case_pg_vertical/bootstrap.py "$VERTICAL_SHA"

.github/workflows/windows-server-enginee.text:
name: ParkWeave Windows Server engineering (mock only)

on:
  push:
    branches: [dev/f1-foundation]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/windows-server-engineering.yml'
      - 'scripts/windows_ci/**'
      - 'scripts/windows/**'
      - 'scripts/run_acceptance.py'
      - 'src/parkweave/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'requirements-windows-candidate.txt'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: parkweave-server-engineering-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  server-engineering:
    name: Server 2025 / Python 3.12 x64 / isolated Job measurement (not Win11)
    runs-on: windows-2025
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - name: Anchor existing 25 minute job budget
        run: |
          # Conservative 30s allowance for bootstrap before this first step.
          $started=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()-30
          "PARKWEAVE_CI_JOB_STARTED=$started" | Add-Content -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_ENV
          $uptime=[Math]::Max(0,[Environment]::TickCount64-30000)
          "PARKWEAVE_CI_JOB_UPTIME=$uptime" | Add-Content -LiteralPath $env:GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Checkout without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Select Python 3.12 x64
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          architecture: 'x64'
      - name: Independent controlled Job measurement without owner helpers
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
          $os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
          if ($os.Caption -notmatch 'Windows Server 2025' -or $os.ProductType -eq 1) {
            throw 'NATIVE_SERVER_PLATFORM_REQUIRED'
          }
          if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath '.runtime')) {
            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.runtime' -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
          }
          # Ordinary exclusive fixture creation only; no SetOwner/Set-Acl.
          # No Engineering.ps1, PostgreSQL, app, pip, model or artifact upload.
          & python -m scripts.windows_ci.controlled_job_measurement --run-controlled
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CONTROLLED_JOB_MEASUREMENT_NOT_PASSED' }
